notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
The following items have been corrected.

A new gimmick "ceiling needle" has been added.
Changed so that players are not knocked back when they come in contact with a gimmick that is moving horizontally.
Fixed unintended jump behavior after record/restore
Fixes to some stages with alternative solutions
Minor bug fixes

We hope you continue to enjoy "FILMECHANISM"!

notes.title: 1.0.2g Update
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where achievements could not be gotten.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes: Changed so that if True End is achieved without seeing Normal End, both achievements will be achieved.
